title: Cookie Policy
intro: This Cookie Policy explains how DevMaster may use cookies and similar technologies to support the website.

sections.heading: What Cookies Are
paragraphs: Cookies are small text files stored on your device by a website. They can help a website remember preferences, maintain basic functionality, and understand how visitors use its pages.

sections.heading: How We May Use Cookies
paragraphs: DevMaster may use cookies or similar technologies that are necessary for the website to function, remember basic preferences, support navigation, or help us understand website performance.

sections.heading: Managing Cookies
paragraphs: Most browsers allow you to review, block, or delete cookies through their settings. Disabling some cookies may affect parts of the website or reduce the functionality available to you.

sections.heading: Third-Party Services
paragraphs: Some website features may rely on third-party services that use their own technologies. Those services are responsible for explaining their own practices in their respective policies.

sections.heading: Policy Updates
paragraphs: We may update this Cookie Policy when the website or the technologies used on it change. The updated version will be published on this page.

sections.heading: Contact Us
paragraphs: If you have questions about this Cookie Policy, please contact the DevMaster team through the contact details available on this website.
